thesis: The rotation call from 11 September is confirmed and larger than I thought: bitcoin funds bled **$463M** last week while ether took $197M. Bitcoin is back to flat on our entry at 78,755 and still range-bound with RSI 51, and today's packet gives it the only negative news tone in the book at -0.67. The reason to prefer BTC within this sleeve has now clearly gone to ETH.
bull_case:
Pattern analyst: setup is a **range** - close 78,755.38, RSI 51 dead centre, 18.8% below the 252-day high, 63d momentum +26.3%, no breakout flag, squeeze 0.91. ATR 2.8% is the tamest crypto we own, so it is the cheapest of the sleeve to hold. Verdict: pattern says wait for a close above 79,661, the position's own high.

The structural bid has not disappeared: US spot bitcoin ETFs took $3.52B in August, the strongest month of 2026, with combined net assets of $103.34B, about 6.32% of market cap. The score has improved to +0.61 from +0.56, the position is back to +0.1% from -1.8%, and the $77k area has now absorbed repeated tests without breaking.
bear_case: Flows reversed hard: $463M out of bitcoin funds last week against $197M into ether. That is the single fact that made BTC the preferred horse in this sleeve, and it is now pointing the other way. The packet's headline tone of -0.67 is the most negative of any symbol in the book. Price is going nowhere - RSI 51, no breakout, a $77-82k range unbroken for two weeks. Macro, once for the day: the FOMC decides Wednesday 16 September and the odds are genuinely contested - Kalshi showed 48% for a 25bp hike while another tracker had the market-implied probability at 83%, so the single most consequential number this week is one nobody agrees on. The CLARITY Act reaches a Senate vote tomorrow, 15 September, on a revised bill with White House-backed ethics concessions. On energy, Iran and Oman have agreed a **temporary** shipping route lasting two to four months that explicitly does not constitute a full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Bitcoin is expected to move 5-10% within hours of Wednesday's decision, which is volatility, not edge. Own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4%, Sharpe -0.15, 17% win rate over 75 trades. Desk record (research/outcomes.json): 11 closed trades, 0 wins, -$148.09 realised, expectancy -2.84% per trade; long memos are now 3 good of 7 judged, a 0.43 hit rate - below a coin flip. The one long memo the engine acted on, NVDA on 6 September, was stopped out at -8.5%. Conviction is capped accordingly and nothing today is written above 0.65.
catalysts: Weekly ETF flow prints and whether the ETH rotation persists
risks: $463M of outflows last week while ether took $197M
Most negative news tone in the book at -0.67
Range-bound with RSI 51 and no breakout
Own backtest: 17% win rate in the crypto sleeve
invalidation: The pattern analyst's level is **73,231.29**, the trailing stop carried in the packet. A close below it ends this. It flips long on a daily close above 82,000 made after the FOMC with ETF flows turned positive again.
